pages.title: Giant Tube Worms
pages.text: Riftia: worms two metres long with no mouth and no gut, living on the bacteria inside them, which live on the vent's sulfide. Their red plumes are full of haemoglobin. Found round the vents of Titan's hidden ocean, where they spread by themselves near a black smoker. The Fermenter grows Bacterial Cultures from their symbionts.
